text:
maria.dev: Heads-up — the CLI sample app publish pipeline is failing regen because of an auth/retry parity change. noticed after bumping the typegen in the release branch.

ci-bot: build 1973.11 failed - regendiff detected in `sample-app/cli-client`
ci-bot: ```
--- a/sdk/clients/cli/retry.ts
+++ b/sdk/clients/cli/retry.ts
@@ -12,7 +12,7 @@
- export function shouldRetry(err) { return err.status >= 500 }
+ export function shouldRetry(err) { return err.status >= 500 || err.code === 'ETIMEDOUT' }
```

sam.engineer: Repro'ed locally. typegen changed optional `authRetry` default from `false` -> `true` which causes different generated client signatures. sample app's integration tests assume the old default.

tyler: hmm — semver question: that default flip is a behavior change, is it documented in changelog? If not, we should treat as breaking for patch releases.

olga: there's an existing `typegen` release note that mentions "auth retries consolidated" but no explicit default change. I think the publish tooling picked up a minor bump but code semantics changed.

maria.dev: Exact: in openapi -> x-sdk-defaults we had `authRetry: true` added accidentally in the regen PR (176->177). That's why codegen generated new default.

kevin: Quick mitigation: revert the x-sdk-defaults change and rerun regen? That should make the diff go away. But we need a test to prevent this slipping through.

sam.engineer: Reverting locally fixed unit tests. But noticed one more: CI linter flags semver mismatch between `package.json` and `CHANGELOG.md` for `sdk-cli` (package.json is 1.4.2, changelog header is 1.4.1). Might be why the publish step aborted.

maria.dev: Ugh — looks like the release stamp job didn't pick up the bumped version from the typegen step because the regen job errored earlier. The pipeline then tried to publish partial artifacts and CI aborted us.

tyler: Action items: 1) revert x-sdk-defaults in openapi and re-run regen, 2) fix changelog/version sync script in the release job so it's atomic, 3) add a small e2e that asserts `sdk-cli` default for authRetry.

olga: For the changelog script: current `scripts/release-sync.sh` reads the package.json and appends to CHANGELOG without a lockfile, so parallel jobs race. I'll open a quick PR to add a git lock file and ensure version rewrite is a single commit.

kevin: I'll open the revert PR for x-sdk-defaults and mark it as hotfix -> `release/stamp` so it doesn't wait for the full release train.

devex-bot: Assigned to @kevin, @olga, @sam.engineer. Milestone: release-hotfix-1973.

sam.engineer: Also proposing a tiny unit test in `sample-app/e2e` that runs `node ./bin/cli.js --dry-run` and asserts the generated client options include `authRetry: false` by default. We can run that in the regen check to catch future regressions.

maria.dev: Good. One more note for docs: if defaults change, we must add an explicit entry in `sdk/CHANGELOG.md` under Unreleased and add a short blurb — otherwise downstream teams get surprised.

tyler: Agreed. I'll also add a CI lint to prevent typegen PRs that add `x-sdk-defaults` keys unless explicitly approved by eng-ml.

olga: PRs: #3405 revert x-sdk-defaults, #3406 release-sync lock, #3407 e2e default test. I'll link them in the release-hotfix thread.

maria.dev: Thanks team. If anyone is blocked, ping me. Will monitor the hotfix pipeline. :eyes:

kevin: FYI I forced the revert PR, CI running now. will follow up when green. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: build 1973.12 started for PR #3405

maria.dev: Closing note — this is a good example of how regen diffs + small OpenAPI metadata edits can create subtle semantic breaks. We need guardrails.

sam.engineer: Agree — small, actionable changes. thanks all. :rocket:
